```{r setup}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)

opts_chunk$set(results = "asis")

# Rendered by `analysis_catalog.summary.render` with the version directory as
# `catalog_dir`. Every number below is a query of that version's catalog.sqlite,
# or a read of its changes.tsv; nothing is recomputed from the Release Bundles.
catalog_dir <- params$catalog_dir
if (!nzchar(catalog_dir)) stop("set the catalog_dir parameter: quarto render ... -P catalog_dir:<version dir>")
con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), file.path(catalog_dir, "catalog.sqlite"), flags = SQLITE_RO)
q <- function(sql) dbGetQuery(con, sql)
meta <- setNames(q("SELECT key, value FROM catalog_meta")$value, q("SELECT key, value FROM catalog_meta")$key)

# The total of a per-Store figure. A Store that does not report it makes the total
# unknown: a partial sum is never presented as a total (CONTRIBUTING.md).
total_of <- function(x) {
  reporting <- sum(!is.na(x))
  if (reporting < length(x)) {
    return(sprintf("unknown (%d of %d Stores report it)", reporting, length(x)))
  }
  format(sum(x), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
}
n_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
label_na <- function(x, text) ifelse(is.na(x) | !nzchar(x), text, x)

selection <- q("SELECT store_id, decision, reason FROM selection ORDER BY store_id")
stores <- q("SELECT * FROM stores ORDER BY store_id")
listed_stores <- stores[stores$store_id %in% selection$store_id[selection$decision == "listed"], ]
n_listed_analyses <- q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM listed_analyses")$n
```

## This version

```{r version}
kable(data.frame(
  Item = c("Catalog version", "Built", "Registry commit", "Builder version"),
  Value = c(meta[["version"]], meta[["built_at"]],
            label_na(meta[["registry_commit"]], "none (the registry was not a git checkout)"),
            meta[["builder_version"]])
))
```

## Totals

```{r totals}
if (nrow(listed_stores) == 0) {
  cat(sprintf("**No Store is listed in this version.** %d Store Releases are registered; see the excluded and refused Stores below for why none is served.\n",
              nrow(selection)))
}
kable(data.frame(
  Total = c("Stores", "Analyses", "Associations"),
  Value = c(n_fmt(nrow(listed_stores)), n_fmt(n_listed_analyses), total_of(listed_stores$n_associations))
))
```

Totals count listed Stores. An association total is `unknown` as soon as one listed Store does not report its association count; it is never the sum of the Stores that do.

## Served Stores

```{r stores}
if (nrow(stores) == 0) {
  cat("No Store is served.\n")
} else {
  decision <- setNames(selection$decision, selection$store_id)
  kable(data.frame(
    Store = stores$store_id,
    Decision = decision[stores$store_id],
    Layout = label_na(stores$layout, "not reported"),
    `Association coverage` = label_na(stores$association_coverage, "not reported"),
    `Completion state` = label_na(stores$completion_state, "not reported"),
    `Access posture` = label_na(stores$access_posture, "not reported"),
    Analyses = ifelse(is.na(stores$n_analyses), "not reported", n_fmt(stores$n_analyses)),
    Associations = ifelse(is.na(stores$n_associations), "not reported", n_fmt(stores$n_associations)),
    check.names = FALSE
  ), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Analyses by Assigned Ancestry

Unassigned Analyses and multi-ancestry (META) Analyses are categories of their own.

```{r ancestry}
counts_of <- function(dimension, missing_text) {
  d <- q(sprintf("SELECT value, n_analyses FROM counts WHERE dimension = '%s' ORDER BY n_analyses DESC, value", dimension))
  d$value <- label_na(d$value, missing_text)
  names(d) <- c("Category", "Analyses")
  d$Analyses <- n_fmt(d$Analyses)
  d
}
show_counts <- function(dimension, missing_text) {
  d <- counts_of(dimension, missing_text)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) cat("No Analyses are listed.\n") else print(kable(d, row.names = FALSE))
}
show_counts("ancestry", "unassigned")
```

show_counts("outcome_type", "undetermined")

## Sample-size distribution

```{r sample-size}
ss <- q("SELECT sample_size_kind AS kind, sample_size FROM listed_analyses")
if (nrow(ss) == 0) {
  cat("No Analyses are listed.\n")
} else {
  ss$kind <- label_na(ss$kind, "not reported")
  has <- !is.na(ss$sample_size)
  cat(sprintf("%s of %s listed Analyses report a sample size.\n\n", n_fmt(sum(has)), n_fmt(nrow(ss))))
  if (any(has)) {
    rows <- lapply(split(ss$sample_size[has], ss$kind[has]), function(x) {
      p <- quantile(x, c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1), names = FALSE)
      c(Analyses = n_fmt(length(x)), Min = n_fmt(p[1]), `25%` = n_fmt(p[2]), Median = n_fmt(p[3]),
        `75%` = n_fmt(p[4]), Max = n_fmt(p[5]))
    })
    print(kable(data.frame(`Sample size kind` = names(rows), do.call(rbind, rows),
                           check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)))
    print(ggplot(ss[has & ss$sample_size > 0, ], aes(sample_size, fill = kind)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
      scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
      labs(x = "Sample size (log scale)", y = "Analyses", fill = "Sample size kind") +
      theme_minimal())
  }
}
```

## Trait Ontology Mapping coverage

```{r mapping}
m <- q("SELECT trait_class, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(trait_ontology_id IS NOT NULL AND trait_ontology_id <> '') AS mapped,
        SUM(analysis_label IS NULL OR TRIM(analysis_label) = '') AS unlabelled
        FROM listed_analyses GROUP BY trait_class ORDER BY trait_class")
if (nrow(m) == 0) {
  cat("No Analyses are listed.\n")
} else {
  all_n <- sum(m$n)
  cat(sprintf("%s of %s listed Analyses (%.1f%%) are mapped to a trait ontology term.\n\n",
              n_fmt(sum(m$mapped)), n_fmt(all_n), 100 * sum(m$mapped) / all_n))
  print(kable(data.frame(
    `Trait class` = m$trait_class, Analyses = n_fmt(m$n), Mapped = n_fmt(m$mapped),
    Unmapped = n_fmt(m$n - m$mapped), `Mapped (%)` = sprintf("%.1f", 100 * m$mapped / m$n),
    check.names = FALSE), row.names = FALSE))
  methods <- q("SELECT trait_ontology_mapping_method AS method, COUNT(*) AS n FROM listed_analyses
                WHERE trait_ontology_id IS NOT NULL AND trait_ontology_id <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC")
  if (nrow(methods) > 0) {
    cat("\nBy mapping method:\n\n")
    print(kable(data.frame(Method = label_na(methods$method, "not reported"), Analyses = n_fmt(methods$n)),
                row.names = FALSE))
  }
}
```

### Analyses with no label

```{r unlabelled}
if (nrow(m) == 0) {
  cat("No Analyses are listed.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%s of %s listed Analyses have no analysis label.\n", n_fmt(sum(m$unlabelled)), n_fmt(sum(m$n))))
}
```

## Excluded and refused Stores

```{r excluded}
x <- selection[selection$decision %in% c("excluded", "refused"), ]
if (nrow(x) == 0) {
  cat("No registered Store Release is excluded or refused.\n")
} else {
  kable(data.frame(Store = x$store_id, Decision = x$decision, Reason = x$reason), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Change since the previous version

```{r change}
changes_path <- file.path(catalog_dir, "changes.tsv")
if (!file.exists(changes_path)) {
  cat("No previous version: nothing to compare.\n")
} else {
  ch <- read.delim(changes_path, sep = "\t", quote = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = character())
  n <- function(kind) sum(ch$change == kind)
  print(kable(data.frame(
    Change = c("Analyses added", "Analyses removed", "Analyses with changed metadata"),
    Count = n_fmt(c(n("added"), n("removed"), n("changed")))
  )))
  cat("\nEvery changed id is in `changes.tsv` beside this report.\n")
}
```

dbDisconnect(con)
